SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.272899, -89.358471 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 390600 gallon
Report Description
* AN OFFSHORE SKIMMER REPORTED THREE SHEENS IN MISSISSIPPI CANYON #209 * THE SHEENS WERE APPROXIMATELY: 3.7 MILES X 0.1 MILES, 2.0 MILES X 100 YARDS, 02 MILES X 100 YARDS IN SIZE * THE SOURCE OF THE SPILL WAS DUE TO A SUB-SEA PIPELINE THAT CRACKED AT THE JUMPER LINE, GOING FROM THE OIL WELL HEAD TO THE OIL RIG * THE PIPELINE WAS SHUT IN * THE PLATFORM NAME IS MC 254A AND IS OWNED BY LLOG EXPLORATION * THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY ACTIVATED CLEAN GULF ASSOCIATES (CGA) & THE MARINE SPILL RESPONSE CORPORATION (MSRC) * A 95-FOOT RESPONSE VESSEL (R/V) FROM CGA AND A 210-FOOT R/V FROM MSRC WERE DEPLOYED * APPROXIMATELY 7,900 - 9,300 BARRELS (331,800 - 390,600 GALLONS) OF LIGHT CRUDE OIL WERE RELEASED * THE AMERICAN PETROLEUM INSTITUTE (API) GRAVITY OF THE PRODUCT IS 38.5 * (FOR REFERENCE: IF API GRAVITY IS GREATER THAN 10, IT FLOATS ON WATER, IF IT IS LESS THAN 10, IT SINKS) * THERE IS MINIMAL OIL SURFACE EXPRESSION, LIGHT TO SILVERY SHEENS WITH SMALL PATCHES OF RAINBOW WERE REPORTED ON THE SURFACE * THE R/VS ARE UTILIZING X-BAND AND INFRARED EQUIPMENT TO TRACK DOWN THE PRODUCT, BUT SO FAR HAVE NOT RECOVERED ANY.

IT APPEARED DARK AGAINST THE SURROUNDING OCEAN SURFACE, WIDENED SLIGHTLY WITH DISTANCE, WAS SEGMENTED, AND HAD A BLUNT, WELL DEFINED CUTOFF WITH AN OVERALL UNNATURAL SHAPE.
